ns2:course.label: Field Study and Thesis Seminar
ns2:course.description: (SP ED 491) Planning field studies and thesis problems by doctoral candidates; students present their studies at each of four stages: (1) the inception, delimitation, tentative design stage; (2) the proposed design stage; (3) the revised design stage; and (4) the final design stage. Students are expected to analyze all presentations critically Prerequisite: Admission to doctoral studies or Special Education or consent of instructor.
